51566308.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to C-terminal 6His-tagged SARS-COV-2 recombinant S protein (Val16 to Arg685 residues) expressed in mammalian expression system assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface plasmon: Compound S-10 was fixed on the chip by photo-crosslinking, then recombinant SARS-CoV-2 S-trimer protein (DRA 47, Novoprotein Inc. Shanghai) at indicated concentrations was injected sequentially into the chamber in buffer PBST (0.1% Tween 20, pH 7.4). The interaction of S-trimer with compound S-10 fixed was detected by PlexArrayTM HT SPRi (Seattle, US). The reaction temperature was controlled at 4 °C, binding time was 600 s, dissociation time was 360 s, flow rate was 0.5 μL/s. The chip was regenerated with Glycine Hydrochloride (pH 2.0), binding data of interaction signals was retrieved and analyzed with PlexeraDE software [33].
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Fig. 4. (A) Dose-response curves and EC50 of S-10 on inhibiting the entry of SARS-CoV-2 PsV and VSV-G in 293T-ACE2 cells. (B) Evaluation of S-10 on cytotoxicity against 293T Cells. (C) SPR analysis of the interaction between S-10 with SARS-CoV-2 S. (D) Dose-response curves and EC50 of S-10 on inhibiting the entry of other SARS-CoV-2 variants PsV.
original_paragraph.Figure 4C sensorgram data: The SPR sensorgram in Figure 4C shows the interaction between S-10 and SARS-CoV-2 S protein. The x-axis represents time (s) from 0 to 1000. The y-axis represents the response units (RU). The curves are labeled with concentrations: 2 μM, 4 μM, 8 μM, 16 μM, 32 μM. The sensorgram shows association (increasing RU) and dissociation (decreasing RU) phases. The text within the plot indicates the calculated dissociation constant: K_D = 3.26 μM.
